capabilities: Render Base entries as compact cards with cover images and property pills
Scroll a Feed view of lazy-rendered Markdown note previews
Plot date-bearing notes on a Gantt-style Timeline with grouped, color-coded lanes
Create new notes in a configured folder from a configured template linked to a Base
Show built-in per-view help from the Bases toolbar
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README says community-plugin directory availability is pending acceptance.
intentEvidence: A lightweight companion to Obsidian's native Bases views.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Bases views lack a compact card layout, full note-preview feeds, and a Gantt-style date timeline.
summary: Adds three Notion-style views (Cards Compact, Feed, Timeline) to Obsidian's native Bases.
